subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class full-bleed dashboard tab-app layout, or keep the current plugin-tab native/iframe surfaces as the app-level extension point for now?
rationale: The request changes the operator-admin web surface and custom-widget app boundary; current main only has generic plugin-tab plumbing, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security shape.

options.title: Keep Roadmap-Owned
options.body: Keep this issue open under the modular-dashboard roadmap until Wave 1 and the security model are reviewed, then implement a bounded tab-app design if approved.

options.title: Approve A Bounded Implementation
options.body: Allow a future PR to add a single-widget full-bleed layout after the workspace document, widget registry, approval flow, and sandbox proof are in place.

options.title: Use Existing Plugin Tabs Only
options.body: Decline a dashboard-specific tab-app layout and document native bundled plugin tabs or descriptor iframe tabs as the supported app surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Roadmap-Owned
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under the modular-dashboard roadmap until Wave 1 and the security model are reviewed, then implement a bounded tab-app design if approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin-tab seam was introduced through the Logbook Control UI work, making this the closest observed owner boundary for a product-direction call.
